repos.description: The most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library
repos.summary_zh: FingerprintJS是最先进的免费开源浏览器指纹识别库，通过客户端查询浏览器属性计算哈希访客标识符。与Cookie不同，它在隐身模式和清除数据后仍保持一致。适用于访客识别、欺诈检测和Web分析等场景。技术亮点包括npm/CDN简单安装、MIT许可、高兼容性和React支持。提供演示展示持久性，但准确性低于商业版且易被欺骗。
repos.summary_en: FingerprintJS is the most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library. It generates a unique hashed visitor identifier by querying browser attributes on the client-side. Unlike cookies, the fingerprint remains consistent in incognito mode and after clearing browser data. It is ideal for visitor identification, fraud detection, and analytics in web applications. Key highlights include easy installation via npm or CDN, MIT license, high compatibility, and React support. A demo is available to showcase its persistence. However, it has lower accuracy than commercial versions and is vulnerable to spoofing.

repos.description: Check if an email address exists without sending any email, written in Rust. Comes with a ⚙️ HTTP backend.
repos.summary_zh: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源工具，可在不发送邮件的情况下验证邮箱地址是否存在及可交付性。提供 Docker HTTP 后端（最受欢迎）、CLI 工具和 Rust 库三种方式。核心亮点包括 SMTP 连接探测、MX 记录验证、一次性邮箱与角色账号检测、catch-all 判断等，输出详细 JSON 结果。适用于邮件营销、用户注册验证、数据清洗及反欺诈场景，支持代理以实现大规模处理，采用双许可模式。
repos.summary_en: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists is a high-performance Rust open-source tool to verify email address existence and deliverability without sending any emails. It provides a popular Dockerized HTTP backend, CLI tool, and Rust library for integration. Key features include syntax validation, MX record checks, SMTP probing, detection of disposable emails, role accounts, catch-all addresses, and more, with detailed JSON output on reachability. Ideal for email marketing, user onboarding, data cleaning, and fraud prevention. Supports proxies for scale and uses dual licensing.

repos.description: Beancount: Double-Entry Accounting from Text Files.
repos.summary_zh: Beancount 是一种基于文本的复式记账领域特定语言，将会计逻辑代码化。通过纯文本文件定义交易记录，支持自动化报告生成和 Web 界面展示，适用于个人理财与中小企业记账。v3 版本保持极简主义设计，强调持久性与可编程性，为开发者提供灵活的财务管理工具。
repos.summary_en: Beancount is a text-based domain-specific language for double-entry bookkeeping that codifies accounting logic into plain text files. It enables automated report generation and provides a web interface for visualization. Designed for personal finance and small business accounting, Beancount emphasizes minimalism, durability, and programmability. The current stable v3 version offers developers a flexible, scriptable financial management tool that treats accounting as code, ensuring long-term data portability and extensibility.
